mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% for three consecutive months reduces the risk-free rate, lowering equity discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors shift capital toward equities.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate falls below 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals labor market tightness that increases consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE remains below 4.5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous industrial production above 100 and housing starts exceeding 1200 thousand units indicate robust manufacturing and construction activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through sustained economic momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO > 100 and HOUST > 1200.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate increase above 1.0% for two consecutive months signals monetary tightening that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuation multiples, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains above 1.0% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Positive real GDP growth (GDPC1) above 1% annualized indicates expanding economic activity that supports corporate profit growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when GDPC1 growth exceeds 1% annualized.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 1200 thousand units for two consecutive months signal strong consumer confidence and construction activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST remains above 1200 for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous labor force growth (PAYEMS > 143000) and low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) indicate accommodative monetary policy supporting strong employment, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: labor market expansion with low rates
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS > 143000 and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, high employment (PAYEMS > 144000) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.5%) signal overheating that triggers rate hike expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 144000 and UNRATE < 4.5%.
